content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text treats the Romans 1:3 descent evidence against the conception texts as underdetermined for lack of an explicit textual resolution of paternity, which is the chain-versus-chain collision K-C governs.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D6 vs C4 (Romans 1:3): UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] section A.1-2 and [CR3] Link 6 premises 1-3, where descent according to the flesh is weighed against conception of the Holy Ghost without explicit textual resolution of paternity.","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"'that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires': read narrowly, this bars using a single verse's silence as a contrary statement; read as the judge used it, lack of an explicit textual resolution can still leave the collision underdetermined.","why":"The judge labels the Romans 1:3/conception collision underdetermined because there is no explicit textual resolution of paternity, which is the retired stating-verse demand rather than a chain-by-footing weighing."}
